invariants.rationale: instantTime is a String parameter typically representing a timestamp or identifier, and is likely not null at the entry.
instantToRollback is needed to identify what to roll back, so it is expected to be non-null.
It is plausible that restore mode and marker-based rollback should not both be enabled simultaneously.
Timeline publishing may not be skipped during restore operations; expressing that if isRestore, skipTimelinePublish should likely be false.
The HoodieEngineContext is required for execution, so should not be null.
